import sys
from collections import deque

input = sys.stdin.read().split()
t = int(input[0])
index = 1
results = []

for _ in range(t):
    n = int(input[index])
    s = input[index + 1]
    index += 2
    prefix = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(n):
        prefix[i + 1] = prefix[i] + (1 if s[i] == 'a' else 0)
    min_length = float('inf')
    queue = deque()
    for i in range(n + 1):
        diff_b = prefix[i] - (i - prefix[i])
        diff_c = prefix[i] - (i - (prefix[i] - (s[:i].count('c') if i > 0 else 0)))
        while queue and prefix[queue[0]] > prefix[i]:
            queue.popleft()
        while queue and prefix[queue[-1]] >= prefix[i] - diff_b and prefix[queue[-1]] >= prefix[i] - diff_c:
            queue.pop()
        queue.append(i)
        if queue and prefix[i] - prefix[queue[0]] > 0 and prefix[i] - prefix[queue[0]] > i - queue[0] - (prefix[i] - prefix[queue[0]]) and prefix[i] - prefix[queue[0]] > i - queue[
                0] - ((i - queue[0]) - (prefix[i] - prefix[queue[0]])):
            min_length = min(min_length, i - queue[0])
    results.append(str(min_length) if min_length != float('inf') else '-1')

print('\n'.join(results))
